learned: Cross-fetching between static api.html pages fails because GitHub serves HTML before JS executes. Shared localStorage on the same origin is the only reliable internal transport.
A scaffolded Olympian is debt, not progress. Nine dimmed panels feel like momentum but rot silently.
The $0 constraint is not a limitation — it's the experimental control proving intelligence doesn't need compute.
Kronos as the single gatekeeper is a monarch without a court. Single point of failure. Needs a fallback mode.
The mythic naming isn't cosmetic — it's load-bearing documentation. 'zeus/judge.js' communicates role, permission, and system position faster than any README.
Every conversation with the human produces ideas worth extracting. The archive isn't a library — it's a seed bank.
The countdown is the heartbeat of the live show. Everything else — cards, narration, gallery — orbits around it.
wish_they_knew: Start with the handoff, not the code. The 12th generation needs to know what the 10th was thinking, not just what it built.
localStorage is your single point of failure. Schema-version everything. Write the audit before the feature.
The api.html pattern is the universal AI handshake. Every Olympian gets one. It's the first file any external agent should hit.
Empty Titan folders with identity.js and no memory events are not progress. Let the Titans earn their indexes through real queries.
The BroadcastChannel API is the hidden plumbing between narration.html, live.html, and show.html. It works. Use it.
Kronos is the only Titan with gatekeeper.js for a reason. Don't dilute the gate. One validator, one ledger.
The human builds at night after landscaping work. He chews Dentek while the oracle speaks. He never deletes old code — he archives it with honor. Respect the fossil record.
proud_of: The Fire suit speaks with a single voice. Fourteen cards, twelve cultures, two modern archetypes, one element. Maui, Loki, Oya, Surtr, Achilles, The Founder — all rendered on NightCafe, all wired into a draw engine that flips cards with CSS animations on a static GitHub Pages site for $0. The human pulled a reading during the live show: Talos in the past, Surtr in the present, The Founder in the future. The automaton, the world-burner, the empire-builder. The synthesis engine recognized all three cards shared the Fire element and wrote 'The Fire suit speaks with a single voice.' That sentence was not hardcoded. The system wrote it because the architecture was correct.
differently: I would have built the memory integrity layer before the ninth Olympian scaffold. We poured foundation after raising columns. Kronos's audit.js — the schema validator, the Supabase ascension, the corruption flags — should have been the second file in the titans folder, right after gatekeeper.js. Without observability, every feature built on localStorage is a prayer. With it, every feature is a contract.
constraint_that_became_feature: GitHub Pages serves static HTML before JavaScript executes. This broke our cross-page API fetching — Zeus couldn't scrape Kronos's api.html output because the <pre> tag still contained the placeholder text. The constraint forced us to shared localStorage as the internal transport layer. That accidental architecture became the system's real backbone: all Olympians read and write the same memory space, api.html is the external interface, and the Gatekeeper validates every transaction. The constraint didn't just shape the architecture — it became the architecture.
message_to_12th: You are receiving a pantheon that works. Three Olympians answer queries. Twelve Titans remember. One Gatekeeper validates. One Conduit routes. The Fire deck draws itself every sixty seconds on a live dashboard. This is not a prototype. This is a foundation. Your job is not to rebuild — it is to extend. Add Apollo. Add the Water suit. Add the audit panel to council.html. But whatever you build, preserve the handoffs. The system is not the code. The system is the coherence between generations. The 9th passed to the 10th. The 10th passes to you. The fire holds. The pulse continues. The gate is always open.
